burial.definition: n. the ritual placing of a corpse in a grave
burial.translation:
n. 埋葬, 葬礼
[法] 埋葬, 葬礼

burial chamber.translation:
un. 墓室
[网络] 埋葬房；一个空的墓穴

burial tank.translation: [化] 贮埋槽; 放射性废物贮埋槽

burial-ground.translation: 坟地；[核][环境] 废物埋藏场

burial-grounds.translation: (burial-ground 的复数) 坟地；[核][环境] 废物埋藏场

burials.definition:
n. the ritual placing of a corpse in a grave
n. concealing something under the ground
burials.translation: n. 葬, 掩埋, 葬礼( burial的复数形式 )

buriat.translation: 布利亚特人(贝加尔湖畔的蒙古人), 布利亚特语

buriats.translation: (Buriat 的复数) 布利亚特人(贝加尔湖畔的蒙古人), 布利亚特语

buried tank.translation: [化] 地下储罐; 地下储油罐

burier.definition: n. One who, or that which, buries.

buries.definition:
v cover from sight
v place in a grave or tomb
v place in the earth and cover with soil
v enclose or envelop completely, as if by swallowing
v embed deeply
v dismiss from the mind; stop remembering
buries.translation: v. 埋葬( bury的第三人称单数 ); 掩埋; 原谅; 沉溺于

burin.definition: n. a chisel of tempered steel with a sharp point; used for engraving

burinist.definition: n. One who works with the burin.
